prompt: Who was previously appointed prime minister of the United Kingdom, becoming the first one to win a general election since Tony Blair in 2005?
answer: Sir Keir Starmer. He became prime minister in July 2024 after Labour won the general election—the first Labour victory since Tony Blair’s in 2005.
